messages:
anika: heads up — after the canary deploy I’m seeing a 20-40% tail increase on TP all-reduce for seq len 1024 workloads. Ring seems to spike when per-GPU message > 1.2MB.

matt: ouch. did we change NCCL params or chunking?

anika: I didn't touch nccl settings. suspect kernel selection + batching changed effective msg sizes. quick profile attached below.

perf-bot: (perf snapshot) job=tp-run-1423, model=gpt-13B, GPUs=8, avg_step=0.45s -> 0.62s, allreduce overhead increased from 80ms -> 210ms

sara: can you paste the nvprof/NCCL trace? ring vs tree ops?

anika: pasted below. TL;DR: ring allreduce shows many small p2p ops but a few big ones dominate latency. tree algo reduces number of hops but increases peak bandwidth.

anika: ```
# nccl_trace snippet
[0] allReduce start size=1310720 bytes time=18.2ms
[1] allReduce chunk size=262144 bytes time=2.1ms
[2] allReduce chunk size=262144 bytes time=2.0ms
[3] allReduce chunk size=262144 bytes time=2.2ms
[4] allReduce chunk size=262144 bytes time=2.3ms
# earlier (baseline) allReduce size=655360 bytes total time=78ms
# after change total time=210ms for size=1310720
```

matt: interesting — we also modified the batching heuristic to prefer bigger micro-batches at low qps to improve throughput. that would increase KV cache reuse but also message sizes.

sara: possible interplay: bigger micro-batches -> longer seqs -> bigger KVCACHE sync payloads -> larger allreduce messages. Have we measured comm/compute overlap?

anika: yes, overlap dropped. compute was expected to hide ~60ms, now hides ~10ms. looks like allreduce is now on the critical path.

matt: can we force tree algorithm for a quick A/B? NCCL supports topology hints.

anika: tried `NCCL_ALGO=tree` on canary — latency normalized back to ~0.5s total. ring stayed high.

ops-bot: deploy note: rolled tree config to 10% of traffic for experiment (canary id: tp-tree-17425).

sara: good signal. but tree consumes more bandwidth and can be worse on some HW; we should be careful for multi-host setups. need full perf sweep across msg sizes [128KB..2MB].

matt: agreed. action items: 1) bisect batching change to reproduce msg size inflection, 2) run nccl bandwidth/latency microbench across sizes, 3) add dynamic algo selection heuristic (prefer tree >1MB).

anika: I'll collect microbench data and share plots. early guess: threshold ~900KB where ring's latency slope increases.

sara: also add a KV cache flush metric to traces so we can correlate when large syncs happen.

anika: noted. quick temporary mitigation: lower micro-batch cap for canary to keep per-GPU msg < 800KB. will roll in 5m. :thumbsup:

matt: thanks. if tree experiment stays stable we can add runtime switch: pick tree for large-message phases and ring otherwise. wants a PR?

anika: yes — will open one after I upload bench CSVs. naming: `tp/nccl/dyn-algo-msgsize`

perf-bot: (reminder) schedule: perf sweep queued on perf-labs, ETA 3h.

sara: perfect. keep the thread updated with plots and the raw nccl traces. :mag:
